name: Marriott Breach
actor: Individuals on behalf of the Chinese Government
desc: A data breach at the Marriott hotel group in 2018.

acts.d: Phishing email used to gain access to Starwood brands reservation system
Attackers obtained valid passwords/accounts to move laterally within the network

A remote access trojan was found during investigation. Generally, RATs allow an attacker to covertly access, surveil, and even gain control over a computer. However, it is unknown how attackers used the RAT in this attack.
Attackers used an administrator account to query for data within the network. Attackers searched for databases with relevant customer information.
Attackers obfuscated data that they removed from the network
Attackers obfuscated data that they removed from the network by compressing and encrypting files
Attackers conducted defense evasion by deleting exfiltrated files
